Vimeo
Optional public API access for global video search and comments
Vimeo keyword search requires a public API token. Open Vimeo settings to enable search, then return to continue with your query.
Open Vimeo settings
Paste a public or shared unlisted Vimeo video, creator, channel, showcase or event link.
Set public API token
Not configured. Public videos, showcases and events work without a token.
Public API access is configured on this device. Search and public video comments are available.
Vimeo API access token

Paste an unauthenticated Vimeo API token with only the public scope. It enables global video search and reading public comments. The token stays encrypted on this device and is excluded from backups and Device Sync.
Verify and save
Enter the access token alone, without the Bearer prefix or spaces.
Vimeo could not verify a public-only token. Check the token, its permissions, your connection and API request limits, then try again.
Could not update the securely stored Vimeo token.
Vimeo search and public comments enabled
How to get a public token
Open Vimeo’s instructions. Create an API app, then choose an Unauthenticated token for public data only.
Remove API token
Disable API search and comments on this device. Public playback and showcases remain available.
Vimeo API token removed
